Hello,

New version 1.4.7 is available for download (fix some players issues caused by update 1.4.6). In some cases, you will have to set the language again. In a previous update, I accidentally removed one of the 90 languages.

- Performance fixes (low-end)
- Fixes for gamepads
- Update for (Windows 32 bit, Windows 64 bit, Linux 64 Bit, Mac 64 bit)
- Other minor fixes

notes.title: The new update 1.4.6 is available, demo & multiplayer information
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575536/cc60e1e8b54178f57b44bfe025fa91cc346901f1.gif

The Resoraki has just received a new update (version 1.4.6). This update has been designed to enhance your gaming experience and provide a more enjoyable and exciting adventure :D. 

Thank You for feedback. 

Multiplayer
Soon I will publish a DEMO, and then I will start testing game with multiplayer and server, if everything will be OK, multiplayer for 4-8 players will be added in version 1.5.x. However, I cannot promise that I will be able to maintain the server $$$ for many years (Airem = one person studio). At the moment you can play online for two players via Remote Play Together and in Time trial mode You can find online leaderboards.

Below are the changes that the new update brings:

[olist]
 New track "Training" (Arcade = with AI, Time trial = alone), I test cars here :P
 You can now change the camera view (default key C, gamepad R1/RB) or reset keys. There are 7 types of cameras
 Graphical fixes for some GUI elements
 Added new cars (total of 73 now)
 AI improvements (all tracks, special tracks like Downhill, etc.)
 Added monuments to "Greece 1-3" map (thanks to @nuendo)
 Added options (disable hologram in Time trial mode, effects, change name, etc.)
 Voice over fixes (English/Polish)
 Localization fixes (English, Polish, French etc.)
 Fixes for downhill map (1-3), mini miles (1-3)
 Steamworks API achievements fixes (2_Players, New game, etc.)
 Camera graphical fixes
 Achievements images fixes
 Fixes for some track screens (some displayed the number of tracks)
 Gamepad fixes
 Menu background fixes
 Fixes for some maps
 Game optimization (low-end)
 Resoraki soundtrack  fixed icon
 Updated for Windows 32-bit, Windows 64-bit, Linux 64-bit, and Mac 64-bit
 Preparation for publishing the DEMO version
 Other minor fixes
[/olist]

Changelog: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2303180/discussions/0/5219148750788472314/
